name: Quality Management in Process Industries
description: Quality terminology; management aspects of quality; DMAIC (define, measure, analyze, improve, control) process, discrete and continuous statistical distributions; sampling; two or more distributions, analysis of variance; control chart and magnificent 7; process capability; capability ratios; evaluation of measurement systems; specification limits; estimation of tolerances; introduction of multivariate process control; engineering process control; design of experiments; lot-by-lot sampling for attributes; quality cost and quality audits.
